lead_summary.zh: 美中俄峰會發宣言；台股重挫1,768點

title.zh: 美中俄深圳峰會　發和平宣言少具體承諾
title.en: Trump, Xi, Putin issue peace declaration with few specifics

body.zh: 美國總統川普、中國國家主席習近平與俄羅斯總統普丁 19 日在深圳 APEC 場邊舉行首次三方會談，會後發表聯合「和平宣言」，承諾維持能源穩定供應、增加成品油生產與供應，並就降低核風險與防止核擴散展開對話。多家媒體指出宣言缺乏具體承諾，也未直接提及伊朗戰事。川普稱這是在「創造歷史」，並表示習近平同意荷莫茲海峽必須保持暢通；習近平形容會談積極、富建設性，普丁則說討論非常坦率，烏克蘭並非核心議題。
body.en: US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin held their first three-way meeting on the sidelines of APEC in Shenzhen on the 19th and issued a joint "peace declaration" pledging stable energy flows, higher output of refined petroleum products and a dialogue on reducing nuclear risks and preventing proliferation. Several outlets noted the declaration contained few concrete commitments and did not directly mention the Iran war. Trump said the leaders were "making history" and that Xi agreed the Strait of Hormuz must stay open; Xi called the talks positive and constructive, while Putin described them as very frank and said Ukraine was not the central topic.

title.zh: 國際法院裁定緬甸　對羅興亞人犯種族滅絕
title.en: World Court rules Myanmar committed Rohingya genocide

body.zh: 聯合國國際法院（ICJ）19 日就甘比亞控告緬甸案作出判決，15 名法官中有 9 人認定緬甸對羅興亞人犯下種族滅絕罪，這是該院首度裁定一個國家犯下種族滅絕。法院命令緬甸停止一切暴力、調查並起訴相關責任人、保障羅興亞人安全自願返鄉，並須在兩年內提交執行報告；判決為終局、不得上訴。甘比亞律師團稱這是羅興亞人的里程碑勝利；緬甸過去一貫否認指控，稱軍方行動是回應武裝攻擊的「清剿行動」，但國際法院本身無強制執行權。
body.en: The International Court of Justice ruled on the 19th in The Gambia's case against Myanmar, with nine of 15 judges finding that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, the first time the court has found a state responsible for genocide. It ordered Myanmar to halt all violence, investigate and prosecute those responsible, allow safe and voluntary return of Rohingya, and report on its compliance within two years; the ruling is final and cannot be appealed. The Gambia's legal team called it a landmark victory for the Rohingya, while Myanmar has consistently denied the allegations, describing the military campaign as clearance operations against armed attacks; the court has no power to enforce its rulings.

title.zh: 柏林意願聯盟峰會　普丁稱暫無和談可能
title.en: Berlin hosts Ukraine allies as Putin rules out quick talks

body.zh: 約 40 個支持烏克蘭國家 19 日在柏林舉行「意願聯盟」峰會，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基出席，美國特使魏科夫與庫許納也到場，並先與德國總理梅爾茨短暫會面。歐方同意若和談開啟，將由英、法、德、義、波蘭及歐盟機構的國安顧問代表歐洲利益，澤倫斯基則堅持歐洲必須參與談判。普丁同日在中國表示，克里米亞大橋遇襲後短期內不會與烏克蘭談判，也不會簽署涵蓋能源或黑海的停火；烏方稱當天再度攻擊該橋。
body.en: About 40 pro-Ukraine nations met in Berlin on the 19th for a Coalition of the Willing summit attended by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, who first met briefly with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz. European participants agreed that national security advisers from Britain, France, Germany, Italy, Poland and EU bodies would represent Europe if negotiations open, and Zelensky insisted that Europe must take part. Speaking in China the same day, Putin said there would be no talks with Ukraine soon after the strikes on the Crimean bridge and that Russia would not sign ceasefires covering energy or the Black Sea; Ukraine said it struck the bridge again that day.

title.zh: 阿曼外海油輪遭擊　利雅德高樓受波及
title.en: Tanker hit off Oman; Riyadh tower struck by debris

body.zh: 英國海事貿易行動辦公室（UKMTO）指出，一艘油輪 18 日在阿曼海薩卜以北約 6 浬處機艙遭不明投射物擊中，船員均平安，肇事來源未明。沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德一棟 80 層的公共投資基金大樓遭攔截的胡塞飛彈碎片擊中受損，聯軍另稱攔下一枚飛向沙國南部的巡弋飛彈。伊朗 18 日也以無人機攻擊科威特阿里薩勒姆空軍基地並襲擊巴林，兩國均未通報傷亡；美方官員稱先前打擊格什姆島飛彈發射點屬自衛，川普則表示會以某種方式結束衝突。
body.en: The UK Maritime Trade Operations agency said a tanker was hit in its engine room by an unknown projectile about 6 nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman, on the 18th; all crew were safe and the source was not identified. In Riyadh, the 80-storey Public Investment Fund tower was damaged by debris from an intercepted Houthi missile, and the coalition said it also downed a cruise missile aimed at southern Saudi Arabia. Iran fired drones at Kuwait's Ali Al-Salem Air Base and attacked Bahrain on the 18th, with neither country reporting casualties; a US official called the earlier strike on a missile launch site on Iran's Qeshm Island self-defense, and Trump said he would end the conflict one way or the other.

title.zh: 氣旋阿克萬逼近印度東岸　奧里薩大撤離
title.en: Cyclone Akvan nears India's east coast; Odisha evacuates

body.zh: 強烈氣旋風暴「阿克萬」（Akvan）正朝印度東岸移動，印度氣象局預計 20 日中午前後（當地時間）於安得拉邦北部至奧里薩邦南部之間登陸，登陸時持續風速每小時 90 至 100 公里、陣風達 110 公里。奧里薩邦官員 19 日稱已撤離近 7.2 萬人，印度媒體 20 日報導撤離人數增至約 12 萬人，6 個縣學校停課至 21 日，約 60 班列車取消或改點。這是不到一個月內第三個威脅印度東岸的強烈氣旋。
body.en: Severe cyclonic storm Akvan is heading for India's east coast, and the India Meteorological Department expects it to cross between northern Andhra Pradesh and southern Odisha around noon local time on the 20th, with sustained winds of 90-100 km/h gusting to 110 km/h. Odisha officials said nearly 72,000 people had been evacuated by the 19th, and Indian media reported on the 20th that the figure had risen to about 120,000; schools in six districts are closed through the 21st and about 60 trains were cancelled or rescheduled. It is the third severe cyclone to threaten India's east coast in under a month.

title.en: Anthropic closes up 17% in Nasdaq debut

body.zh: 人工智慧公司 Anthropic 19 日以代號 ANT 在那斯達克掛牌，承銷價 83 美元、高於原訂 70 至 78 美元區間，發行 9.8 億股 A 類股、募資約 813 億美元。首筆成交價 111.50 美元，盤中最高 114.99 美元，終場收 97.17 美元，較承銷價上漲 17.1%，成交約 8.32 億股。不過熱潮未能帶動大盤，持股 Anthropic 的亞馬遜與 Alphabet 當天分別下跌 3.9% 與 3.5%。
body.en: AI company Anthropic listed on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT on the 19th after pricing at US$83, above its earlier US$70-78 range, selling 980 million Class A shares to raise about US$81.3 billion. The first trade was at US$111.50, the stock peaked at US$114.99 and it closed at US$97.17, up 17.1% from the offer price, with about 832 million shares traded. The debut did not lift the broader market, and Anthropic shareholders Amazon and Alphabet fell 3.9% and 3.5% respectively.

title.zh: 金管會加碼限空　逾千檔今禁平盤下空
title.en: FSC tightens short-selling curbs; 1,028 stocks hit today

body.zh: 台股 19 日重挫後，金管會盤後宣布第二波限空措施，自 20 日起個股當日跌幅達 3.5% 以上者，次一交易日融券及借券賣出不得低於平盤價，若跌幅持續達標則延續限制；20 日適用個股達 1,028 檔，約占上市櫃的 51.8%。同時將盤中借券賣出上限由前 30 日均量的 3% 降至 1%，造市與避險需求除外。金管會表示，本週台股波動與跌幅大於國際股市，與上市櫃公司營收獲利表現背離，並否認措施與選舉有關。
body.en: After the TAIEX's plunge on the 19th, the Financial Supervisory Commission announced a second round of short-selling curbs: from the 20th, any stock that falls 3.5% or more in a day cannot be sold short or lent out below the previous close on the next trading day, with the restriction continuing if the decline persists, covering 1,028 stocks, or about 51.8% of listed and OTC shares, on the 20th. It also cut the intraday cap on securities-lending sales from 3% to 1% of the prior 30 days' average volume, with exemptions for market-making and hedging. The FSC said the market had swung and fallen more than overseas markets this week, out of line with listed companies' strong revenue and earnings, and denied any link to the election.

title.zh: 沃爾瑪三度上調財測　電商成長17%
title.en: Walmart lifts outlook a third time; e-commerce up 17%

body.zh: 美國零售龍頭沃爾瑪 19 日公布 2027 財年第三季財報，營收 1,888 億美元、年增 5.2%，調整後每股盈餘 0.65 美元，略高於市場預期的 0.64 美元；美國同店銷售（不含燃油）成長 2.9%，全球電商銷售成長 17%。公司第三度上調全年財測，淨銷售成長目標升至 4.9% 至 5.2%，調整後每股盈餘 2.84 至 2.89 美元，但美聯社指出此展望仍較分析師預期保守，股價當天收跌約 1%。
body.en: Walmart reported fiscal 2027 third-quarter revenue of US$188.8 billion on the 19th, up 5.2%, with adjusted earnings per share of US$0.65, slightly above the US$0.64 analysts expected; US comparable sales excluding fuel rose 2.9% and global e-commerce sales grew 17%. The retailer raised its full-year outlook for the third time, now targeting net sales growth of 4.9% to 5.2% and adjusted EPS of US$2.84 to US$2.89, though AP noted the guidance was more conservative than analysts had expected, and the shares closed down about 1%.

name.zh: 美國證交會（沃爾瑪財報）

title.zh: 放空機構指AMD涉中國風險　股價跌7.7%
title.en: AMD falls 7.7% on short seller's China claims

body.zh: 放空機構 Hunterbrook 19 日發布報告並揭露放空超微（AMD），指稱遭美國商務部列入實體清單的中國伺服器廠浪潮資訊（IEIT）持續在其韌體更新中使用 AMD 軟體，但也承認其資料無法直接證明違反出口管制。AMD 向彭博表示堅決否認不當行為，稱報告扭曲其業務，公司遵守美國出口管制法規。AMD 股價當天收跌約 7.7%，拖累費城半導體指數。
body.en: Short seller Hunterbrook published a report on the 19th disclosing a short position in AMD, alleging that Chinese server maker IEIT, which is on the US Commerce Department's Entity List, has kept incorporating AMD software into its firmware updates, while acknowledging its records do not directly establish an export-control violation. AMD told Bloomberg it firmly denies any wrongdoing, said the report misrepresents its business and stated that it complies with US export laws. AMD shares closed down about 7.7%, weighing on the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index.

title.zh: 沃勒主張12月升息兩碼　Fed鷹聲升溫
title.en: Fed's Waller backs half-point December hike

body.zh: 聯準會理事沃勒 18 日表示，若聯準會不明確預告 1 月續升息，12 月應一次升息 2 碼（50 個基點），理由是 10 月 CPI 月增 0.4%、核心 CPI 月增 0.3%，均高於預期，通膨已近六年高於 2% 目標。紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯則認為情勢不需要激烈行動。10 月會議紀要顯示幾乎所有官員預期進一步升息為適當，目前政策利率區間為 3.75% 至 4.00%，下次會議為 12 月 8 至 9 日。
body.en: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on the 18th that unless the Fed clearly signals another hike in January, it should raise rates by half a point in December, citing October CPI up 0.4% and core CPI up 0.3% on the month, both above forecasts, with inflation above the 2% goal for nearly six years. New York Fed President John Williams said the situation does not call for dramatic action. Minutes of the October meeting showed almost all officials saw further hikes as appropriate; the policy rate range is 3.75% to 4.00% and the next meeting is December 8-9.

headline.zh: 史上第七大跌點　台股重挫1,768點失守年線
headline.en: TAIEX plunges 1,768 points, breaks below year line

body.zh: 加權指數 19 日以 40,145.73 點小跌開出，盤中最高 40,315.53 點，隨後賣壓擴大一路走低，最低 38,259.70 點，終場下跌 1,768.02 點、收 38,426.89 點，跌幅 4.40%，為史上第七大跌點並跌破年線，成交值 8,952.81 億元；上市 69 家上漲、1,014 家下跌、30 家持平，上市櫃合計 283 檔跌停，櫃買指數重挫 22.22 點（7.22%）收 285.33 點。權值股中，台積電跌 75 元收 2,100 元（3.45%），聯發科跌 220 元至 3,720 元（5.58%），台達電跌 60 元至 1,000 元（5.66%），鴻海小跌 0.5 元收 220.5 元，29 類股指數全數收黑。媒體指出，市場對輝達領導層更迭與 AI 投資前景存疑、聯準會升息預期升溫、新台幣盤中貶破 33 元及融資去槓桿不足，共同加重賣壓；金管會盤後宣布擴大限空措施。
body.en: The TAIEX opened slightly lower at 40,145.73 on the 19th, touched 40,315.53 and then slid as selling intensified, hitting a low of 38,259.70 before closing down 1,768.02 points or 4.40% at 38,426.89, the seventh-largest point drop on record and a break below its one-year moving average, on turnover of NT$895.28 billion; 69 listed stocks rose, 1,014 fell and 30 were unchanged, 283 listed and OTC stocks hit limit-down, and the TPEx index sank 22.22 points (7.22%) to 285.33. Among heavyweights, TSMC fell NT$75 to NT$2,100 (3.45%), MediaTek lost NT$220 to NT$3,720 (5.58%), Delta Electronics dropped NT$60 to NT$1,000 (5.66%) and Hon Hai slipped NT$0.5 to NT$220.5, with all 29 sector indices closing lower. Media cited doubts over Nvidia's leadership change and AI spending, rising Fed rate-hike expectations, the NT dollar weakening past 33 per US dollar intraday and incomplete margin deleveraging; the FSC announced expanded short-selling curbs after the close.

flows_note.zh: 外資延續賣超態勢；自營商中避險部位賣超 214.39 億元，投信則連續第二日買超。
flows_note.en: Foreign investors remained net sellers; dealers' hedging accounts sold a net NT$21.439 billion, while investment trusts were net buyers for a second day.

headline.zh: 美股：道瓊重挫1,101點　四大指數跌逾2%
headline.en: US close, Nov 19: Dow sinks 1,101; all four indexes down over 2%

body.zh: 週四（19 日）美股早盤一度走高，隨後全面翻黑，道瓊跌 1,101.11 點（2.19%）收 49,097.06 點，標普 500 跌 2.02% 收 7,175.83 點、連六個交易日下跌，那指跌 2.25% 收 23,879.20 點，費城半導體指數跌 2.41% 收 9,419.72 點，台積電 ADR 跌 2.90% 收 352.09 美元。Anthropic 掛牌首日收漲 17.1%，但未能提振 AI 類股，市場仍擔憂 AI 鉅額支出的回報、相關企業負債及聯準會升息前景；超微因放空報告重挫約 7.7%，輝達跌 3.3%，美光與博通各跌約 2.1%。避險買盤帶動公債殖利率小幅回落，10 年期約 5.05%，恐慌指數 VIX 上升約 15%。
body.en: US stocks rose early on Thursday, November 19, before turning broadly lower: the Dow fell 1,101.11 points (2.19%) to 49,097.06, the S&P 500 dropped 2.02% to 7,175.83 for a sixth straight decline, the Nasdaq lost 2.25% to 23,879.20 and the SOX fell 2.41% to 9,419.72, while the TSMC ADR slid 2.90% to US$352.09. Anthropic closed its first day up 17.1% but failed to lift AI stocks, as investors remained worried about returns on huge AI spending, debt at related companies and the prospect of Fed rate hikes; AMD sank about 7.7% on a short-seller report, Nvidia fell 3.3%, and Micron and Broadcom each lost about 2.1%. Safe-haven buying nudged Treasury yields lower, with the 10-year near 5.05%, and the VIX volatility index rose about 15%.
